transcript: On December 17, 1903, on a sand dune at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, the Wright brothers succeeded in a 12-second flight. They were brothers who, while running a bicycle shop Had kept pursuing a dream of flying Wilbur and Orville, with their own hands, built a wind tunnel And examined the shape of wings over and over again Many people said it was impossible But the brothers never abandoned their dream If birds can fly, we surely can too They believed the wind was strong that morning The aircraft carrying Orville made its brief flight of 12 seconds The distance was about 37 meters Yet that moment was the result of a long effort To achieve controlled, powered flight When Orville landed, the brothers knew that years of work had finally taken flight To be called an inventor meant nothing to them at that instant It was the very first step that humanity had taken toward the sky

segments.text: On December 17, 1903, on a sand dune at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, the Wright brothers succeeded in a 12-second flight.
They were brothers who, while running a bicycle shop
Had kept pursuing a dream of flying
Wilbur and Orville, with their own hands, built a wind tunnel
And examined the shape of wings over and over again
Many people said it was impossible
But the brothers never abandoned their dream
If birds can fly, we surely can too
They believed the wind was strong that morning
The aircraft carrying Orville made its brief flight of 12 seconds
Yet that moment was the result of a long effort
When Orville landed, the brothers knew that years of work had finally taken flight
To be called an inventor meant nothing to them at that instant
It was the very first step that humanity had taken toward the sky
